description: Block received massage at severe/fatal wounds before costs; mental exceptions still perform but cannot restore master energy; keep normal skill/daily/AP rules

edits.old: func('$menu', 'goto', $menu_item_Massage, menu_Massage, 'interaction', 'interaction', '나에게 안마를 시킨다', '<<$slave_name>>의 안마를 받아본다')

 gt 'menu_form'
end
